directions:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production SOURCE sprite sheet for page-mascot, NINE HEAD DIRECTIONS arranged as an exact uniform 3-by-3 grid.
Reference image 1 is the APPROVED character identity and art style. Preserve this specific Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece: compact straw hat with red hatband, tousled short black hair, warm tan skin, stitched scar below his LEFT eye (on the viewer's right in the frontal pose), red open sleeveless vest, one small gold button, cheerful toothy smile, expressive round dark eyes, crisp black anime outlines and warm polished cel shading. Keep the same recognizable face, colors, line weight and head-to-body proportions. Do not redesign him.

This is NINE HEAD DIRECTIONS, not nine expressions. Keep the same happy relaxed eyes-open expression in every tile; only the head and its hat turn. Make the head turns quite obvious and readable at 160px, with the nose and face plane rotating, NOT just the pupils moving.
The BODY must be the SAME FRONT-FACING DRAWING in all nine tiles: neck base, red vest, upper chest and both shoulders stay fixed, equal width, equal baseline and identical shape. Only the head rotates on this stationary torso. Do not turn the torso in profile. Frame a portrait bust: head, neck, upper chest and shoulders only; no arms, hands or lower body.

EXACT LAYOUT: a SQUARE canvas split mathematically into 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows. NINE drawings total, one centered inside each equally sized square cell. No visible grid or borders.
Row 1, left to right: looking UP-LEFT, looking UP, looking UP-RIGHT.
Row 2, left to right: looking LEFT, looking STRAIGHT AT VIEWER, looking RIGHT.
Row 3, left to right: looking DOWN-LEFT, looking DOWN, looking DOWN-RIGHT.
LEFT and RIGHT always mean the VIEWER'S / CANVAS'S left and right. In the middle-left tile his nose points toward the LEFT EDGE OF THE CANVAS; in the middle-right tile his nose points toward the RIGHT EDGE. Use clear three-quarter head rotation, not a back view. Up and down change chin/head pitch.

PROPORTIONS AND MARGINS: head dominant, shoulders about two thirds the head width excluding the hat. Make the straw hat brim compact and fit the ENTIRE HAT inside every tile. Every whole bust occupies about 72-75% of its tile height and no more than 80% of tile width. At least 10% clear space on all four sides of EVERY tile, including under shoulders. Shrink every character equally to preserve generous gaps. All nine shoulders sit at exactly the same height. All nine heads are the same scale. Clean curved bust termination matching the reference.

TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background across the entire canvas. No background color, no painted checkerboard, no shadow, no floating symbols, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Square PNG, high-resolution sprite artwork. A matching reactions sheet will be made next from this sheet, so preserve character details meticulously.
reactions:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: the MATCHING REACTIONS source sprite sheet for page-mascot, exact uniform 3-by-3 grid.
Reference image 1 is the just-generated DIRECTIONS sheet. It is the binding reference for character identity, painting style, size, palette, head and vest details. Reference image 2 is the original approved portrait for identity.
Draw the SAME Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece: compact yellow straw hat with red hatband and straw detail, tousled short black hair, warm tan skin, stitched scar below his LEFT eye (viewer's right), red open sleeveless vest and small gold button, clean dark anime outlines, warm polished cel shading. Copy the facial structure, colors, markings, hat, hair and line weight from the references exactly. Do not simplify, restyle or invent a different version.

All NINE heads face STRAIGHT AT THE VIEWER, head perfectly upright and centered. Only facial expression changes. The torso and its neck base, upper chest, red vest and shoulders must be the EXACT SAME FRONT-FACING DRAWING in the EXACT SAME POSITION AND SCALE in all nine cells. Same shoulder width and same horizontal baseline, matching the CENTER drawing of the directions sheet. The head must have the same size in every cell and match that center drawing. No tilted torso, no arms, no hands, no lower body.

EXACT LAYOUT: a SQUARE image split into 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows, one centered bust in each square cell. Nine expressions in this exact row-major order:
TOP LEFT (1 blink): both eyes closed as happy curved arcs, relaxed smile, no floating symbol.
TOP MIDDLE (2 heart): both eyes closed as happy arcs, pleased smile, ONE SMALL RED HEART floating above the hat with room to spare.
TOP RIGHT (3 sparkle): joyful expression, THREE SMALL GOLDEN SPARKLE STARS in the empty space above the hat.
MIDDLE LEFT (4 surprised): both eyes very round and wide, mouth a small round O.
MIDDLE CENTER (5 wink): one eye playfully closed in a wink, other eye open and bright, confident small toothy smile, head stays straight.
MIDDLE RIGHT (6 bashful): both eyes closed in happy arcs, pronounced warm pink blush on both cheeks, small bashful smile.
BOTTOM LEFT (7 sleepy): closed sleeping eyes, small peaceful mouth, one small blue 'zzz' floating above the hat.
BOTTOM MIDDLE (8 dizzy): both eyes drawn as obvious spiral swirls, wavy wobbly mouth, no floating symbol.
BOTTOM RIGHT (9 delighted): both eyes closed in delighted arcs, mouth open in a large joyful laughing grin.

MARGINS: each entire character, including the straw hat AND floating symbols, fits fully inside its own cell. Draw busts at about 68-72% of cell height to reserve room for symbols; leave at least 8-10% clear space left and right, above symbols and below shoulders. All nine busts share exactly the same scale and placement: DO NOT shrink only cells with symbols. No touching or crossing tile boundaries. Compact hat brim. Clean curved bust termination matching the reference.

TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no background color, no checkerboard, no shadows, no cell grid, no borders, no labels, no watermark. Only 'zzz' is allowed as the tiny reaction symbol; no other text. High-resolution square PNG.
